entities.summary: Tabriz Islamic Art University also known as Tabriz Art University is a public university located in Tabriz, East Azarbaijan, Iran. The university's major focus is on the Islamic art and architecture. The university was established in 1997. Part of the university's faculties separated from Sahand University of Technology.
